current: conceptual = 106/188 primaries (56%); 99 of the 116 posts without research_output are conceptual

reason: Conceptual is a dumping ground. Within it the meta facet already does the real sorting (38 research_agenda, 31 critique), so the scientific facet adds no information for over half the index. The v0 schema had synthesis/strategy/incident as moves; v1 dropped them and everything fell into conceptual.

Structurally identical proposals get conceptual (tkLSeGeemcabAmLkv satiation, Zpsk35WgJRfQ2exjL risk-averse AIs, sFAGPTrveNAEse9Bg sanctuary).
